market_summary: Strong directional momentum across index and metal assets during New York session. US100 displays powerful bullish trend expansion above VAH and session highs, supported by positive CVD. XAUUSD and EURUSD demonstrate clear bearish trend continuation breaking below Value Area Lows backed by strong negative delta pressure. GBPUSD and BTCUSD present choppy/divergent conditions warranting a temporary hold.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4032.56) and below POC (4044.20). CVD is -2.72 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.96), fully agreeing with selling momentum. Current session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is strongly below VWAP (4039.27) and EMA50 (4034.87), pushing beyond the lower ATR band (4007.36) and sweeping through Session Low (3998.34). Recent move was backed by an RVOL > 2.0 yellow bar spike. Entry taken short on forming bar continuation.

signals.level_event: breakout below Session Low and VAL

signals.level_event: rejection at Session Low (1.32661), mean-reverting inside VA

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (28300.06) and above POC (28264.10). CVD is +12.37 (BULLISH) with strong upward slope (+2.95), matching price expansion. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP (28158.44) and EMA50 (28209.69), expanding past upper ATR band (28451.83) to break Session High (28472.65). US100 caveat applies for RVOL tick volume, but trend structure and delta confluence are extremely solid. Buying the breakout.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish strongly above rising VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance above Session High and VAH

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (73946.59) and POC (73650.62). However, CVD is -0.07 (BEARISH / flat) presenting a clear divergence against price action. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73712.36) and EMA50 (73764.90), but rejected heavily off the upper ATR band (74433.57) and Session High (74384.10) with a long upper wick and no RVOL spike. Divergence and rejection suggest waiting for structure.
